flow: X and W: source read, real live write, successful write response, then private commit. Metadata retains source-to-live copy and 576 live reads. Initial parameter validation remains inside the complete task window and is counted separately from source_load_words.
constraints: Use opt26 queued DMA/CPU arbitration through the unchanged official E203 memory fabric and single 32-bit shared SRAM port. Official vendor OUTS_NUM=1 remains unchanged.
Every source payload word is copied once to its configured live address; source storage is immutable.
Private X and W words must match source values and addresses, not only aggregate counts.
No private commit on failed source read, failed live write, or aborted descriptor.
No START before full descriptor completion; W targets only the inactive tile bank.
Do not replace official initial loading with testbench preloading outside the measured window.
This contract is an engineering validation expectation, not official compliance or signoff.
WAIT preserves every original source/live/private transaction; timeout releases control only and never cancels an offered DMA request.
Hardware wait bound is in bus clocks and is not the software device.poll_limit iteration count.
WAIT observes the complete transport busy/drain state. CONTROL RESET bypasses all DMA busy gates without discarding offered or accepted requests.
A permanently unresponsive memory slave can cause repeated bounded control timeouts; it cannot be declared drained or permit descriptor restart.
